top_signals.title: Texas Developer Seeks $3.5 Billion in Debt Financing for AT&T (T) Headquarters
top_signals.summary: The developer behind AT&T Inc.’s new global headquarters in Plano, Texas, is seeking to raise about $3.5 billion via a niche form of financing to fund construction of the sprawling corporate campus.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Banque du Caire Boosts Size of Egypt’s Biggest IPO in a Decade
top_signals.summary: Banque du Caire boosted the stake it’s offering in a long-delayed IPO to 45%, in what would be Egypt’s largest initial public offering in more than a decade.

top_signals.title: Blackstone's Jon Gray says CoreWeave can 'find a way through' financing pressure
top_signals.summary: Blackstone COO Jon Gray says CoreWeave's underlying business is strong despite concerns over its mounting debt.
